# SafetyWing

> > Insurance solutions for remote workers, digital nomads, and global teams across 175+ countries

SafetyWing offers three main insurance products: Remote Health for distributed teams, Nomad Insurance for travelers and digital nomads (Essential and Complete plans), and Nomad Citizen. The platform serves remote workers worldwide with coverage spanning Schengen countries, United States, Canada, and major international hubs.

## Key Topics

- Remote Health
- Nomad Insurance
- Digital nomads
- Remote workers
- Global health insurance
- International coverage
- Employee benefits
- Travel insurance
- Remote teams
- Essential and Complete plans
- Schengen coverage
- GDPR compliance
- Dependents coverage
- Claims processing

## Core Products

- [SafetyWing - Insurance for remote workers](https://safetywing.com): Homepage featuring Nomad Insurance, Remote Health, and Nomad Citizen products
- [Nomad Insurance](https://safetywing.com/nomad-insurance): Nomad Insurance product page with Essential and Complete plan pricing
- [Schedule a Demo | Health Insurance For Global Teams](https://hello.safetywing.com/lets-connect): Demo scheduling for Remote Health global team insurance across 175+ countries
